## 交付情况

**最终成果：`hone` 项目实施计划 FINAL v1.0**，7 个主体章节 + 附录 A 裁定记录，可直接作为执行团队唯一契约（成员看不到讨论，全部关键契约已写全）：

1. **§0 定稿摘要**：四条必背铁律——叶子值=原始列名、逐层相对名上下文、CSV 一次读取缓存、样例副本入库+HONE_TASK_DIR 覆盖。
2. **§1 验收 G1–G13**：每条带可复制命令与断言。
3. **§2 契约**：布局与互斥文件所有权；`Hone` 12 方法签名与语义；`CSVUtils`（`_load()` 单次读取缓存）；16 条边界（空文件/仅表头/行短键省略/重复表头/`-` 流/多字符分隔符/BOM/CRLF）；CLI 完整契约与退出码 0/1/2 + `-d/-s` 引号警告。
4. **§3 算法**：语法候选 → 本层 `choose(rel)` 两条语义规则（共享前缀、前缀是本层完整列名则阻断）→ 逐层 `(rel, orig)` 递归伪码；含 `x_y`/`x_y_z` 与 comma_test 反例审计、example_b 特例、schema 递归映射。
5. **§4 任务包 A/B/C/D**：阶段0 A 建 base commit（骨架+CONTRACT.md+fixtures 副本+路径 helper）→ 4 个 worktree 并行 → 固定合并顺序 B→A→C→D、A 为唯一合并人、每步门禁命令。
6. **§5 测试 E1–E24**：三组 data_file、examples a/b/c（内联期望，example_b 修正为 `"12"` 并注明上游笔误）、CLI 三条通道、精确 stdout、stdin 单次消费、多字符分隔符、编码、schema 混合、打包、demo、状态隔离与深拷贝不变性。
7. **§6 发布**：pyproject 全文（1.0.0、无依赖、console script、显式 packages）、构建/venv 跨平台命令、4/4 全员交叉验收与回退规则。
8. **§7 风险表**（13 项）+ 升级机制；**附录 A** 记录 24 条 R2 争议的最终裁定及理由，明确采纳了 Leader 的 7 项必改与成员1 的 5 项 P0/P1 修正（含 `get_valid_splits` 定为纯语法候选、行短/schema 缺列统一"省略键"、`escape_quotes` 改为 CSV 双写、4/4 验收等取舍）。

definition.description: 平等组员 · Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

definition.description: 平等组员 · Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.
definition.name: ext_40d5afe2e195effcd613a4ce

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

definition.name: ext_70e0faae9cf86a4577efde5c

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

definition.description: 平等组员 · Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.
definition.name: ext_b42e9fbffdeef840c1bce5b1

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

definition.description: 平等组员 · Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.
definition.name: ext_c8b907273aaff03766b09cbe

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

definition.description: 平等组员 · Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.
definition.name: ext_a512c0f9b2daa28c077d3629

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

definition.description: 平等组员 · Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

definition.description: 平等组员 · Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.
definition.name: ext_db710c38b8752160d8d0dde3

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

definition.description: 平等组员 · Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.
definition.name: ext_fa0a4857ee774b8ddf4dcf33

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

definition.description: 根 Agent · 用户入口 · Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.
definition.name: ext_94673dbbc3228c9133e0699a

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

definition.description: 根 Agent · 用户入口 · Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.
definition.name: ext_94b7663dbf7296932a911462

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

definition.description: 根 Agent · 用户入口 · Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.
definition.name: ext_ed98abef131cc94d7536d93e

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

definition.description: 根 Agent · 用户入口 · Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.
definition.name: ext_f83fad5f6d72a03265ee472b

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.
